text:
maria_cs: Heads up — CrescentHealth has a multi-region demo tomorrow 2026-03-22 14:00 UTC. They requested two temporary changes before the run: add their corporate IPs to the EU edge allowlist and bump per-account QPS from 40 -> 120 for a 6‑hour window starting 2026-03-22T13:30Z. Account: crescent-prod-02. IPs: 203.0.113.45, 203.0.113.46. Can ops/infra confirm capacity and schedule?

sam_platform: @maria_cs copying infra — what's the exact IP CIDR? Need to add to edge ACLs and to VPC peering rules.

maria_cs: They're single IPs (not CIDR): `203.0.113.45`, `203.0.113.46`. Also asked for an EU->US failover route during the demo window in case EU latency spikes.

lee_eng: We can add the two IPs to the EU edge allowlist and add a routing tag for us-west fallback. Quick check on reserved pools: EU GPU pool has ~15% headroom right now; 120 qps sustained for 6h should be OK if we enable burst capacity. I'll need a canary policy: route first 5% to fallback then 100% if stable.

tim_oncall: Will require manual rate-limit override. I'll schedule the change window and monitor. Proposed config:
```
{"account":"crescent-prod-02","qps":120,"window":"2026-03-22T13:30Z/2026-03-22T19:30Z","allowlist":["203.0.113.45","203.0.113.46"],"fallback_region":"us-west","canary_pct":5}
```
Apply at 2026-03-22T13:25Z. I'll run smoke tests after apply.

sam_platform: Please also add a note to the console rollout with the account tag and set an alert if 95th pct token latency > 800ms for 5m.

ops-bot: [policy-check] allowlist addition OK, no IP conflicts. Auto-revert not configured — manual revoke required.

lee_eng: One more note: enable prefix caching for this account's chat route — reduces tokens served by ~18% for conversational flows. I can flip it during the same window.

maria_cs: Awesome — please confirm when done and I'll tell CrescentHealth support to join the monitor channel. :thumbsup:

tim_oncall: Will post final confirmation in this thread once change is live and attach smoke run logs.
